Introduction

Turbo (Korean: 터보; Japanese: ターボ) is a three-member boy group under Turbo JK Company. Originally as duo, they debuted on July 1, 1995 with their first album "280km/h Speed". In 1997, Kim Jung Nam left the duo due conflicts with the management. He was replaced by Mikey. On December 2, 2015, Kim Jong Kook announced that the duo re-formed as a three-member group would be reuniting in celebration of their 20th anniversary since debut. The studio album, titled "Again", was released on December 21, 2015.
